scope: Three authoritative City bicycle-planning files already present in the durable queue: the complete 2024 combined edition and two separately published 2011 plan companions.
remaining_storage_note: Project-wide totals cannot yet be estimated defensibly because most pending candidates have not been reviewed or sized. No candidates remain in this bounded three-document batch.

files.title: 2011 Albuquerque Bikeways and Trails Master Plan Update — Appendices
2011 Albuquerque Bikeways and Trails Master Plan Update — Design Guidelines
files.large_file_reason: The 72-page technical manual is illustration-heavy and contains facility diagrams, dimensions, photographs, intersection treatments, cross sections, and design examples.
files.smaller_authoritative_version: none identified; later plans are successors rather than substitutes for this historical 2011 guidance
files.optimization: possible only by recompressing or downsampling the authoritative visual source; not proposed because that would alter the preserved document and could reduce the usefulness of its diagrams

files.title: 2024 Bikeway and Trail Facilities Plan — Combined Authoritative Edition
files.large_file_reason: The 513-page combined City edition contains the full plan, crossings guide, maps, project profiles, survey results, evaluation material, and all separately published appendices in one visual document.
files.smaller_authoritative_version: the City also publishes the main plan and appendices as smaller authoritative components, but those are not a byte-identical or equivalent single-file combined edition
files.optimization: possible only by altering the authoritative combined source; not proposed because the original is useful as a complete archival snapshot and fidelity matters
